name: Illinois
title: Illinois Rebate Calculator 2026: ComEd, Nicor Gas, Peoples Gas and Naperville Rebates
h1: Illinois Rebate Calculator 2026: What Your Utilities Pay
desc: Free Illinois rebate calculator for ComEd, Naperville Electric, Nicor Gas and Peoples Gas customers. Heat pump, water heater, thermostat, furnace and insulation rebates, with the official source for every amount.
intro: Illinois rebates come from your electric and gas companies. Pick yours and this calculator adds up what each pays today.
short: Illinois has no open statewide heat pump rebate in 2026. ComEd takes up to $2,000 off a heat pump and up to $750 off a heat pump water heater. Naperville's city electric utility pays up to $1,800 for a heat pump. Nicor Gas and Peoples Gas pay for gas furnaces, water heaters, thermostats and weatherization. Ameren Illinois amounts could not be confirmed.
faq: Is there a statewide heat pump rebate in Illinois?
Not yet. The state's HOMES and HEAR rebates have not launched. Your electric utility is the main source: ComEd pays up to $900 to $2,000 and Naperville Electric pays $900 to $1,800.
Why does the calculator ask for my gas company?
Gas companies pay rebates for furnaces, boilers, water heaters, thermostats and insulation that the electric company does not.
Why does Ameren Illinois show no amount?
We could not read Ameren Illinois's rebate page, so we show no amount rather than guess.
Is the federal tax credit still available?
No. The 25C and 25D credits ended after December 31, 2025.
Can I add all the rebates together?
The total adds programs that pay for different upgrades. Check each program's rules, since a few cannot be combined.

programs.name: Naperville Electric heat pump
programs.rules: Replacement air source heat pump. Apply within 120 days. Ends when funding is allocated.

programs.name: ComEd heat pump water heater
programs.rules: ENERGY STAR model with the required efficiency score. Confirm with ComEd before you buy.

programs.name: Peoples Gas tankless or indirect water heater
programs.rules: Gas tankless 0.95 UEF or better, or indirect 88% AFUE or better. Apply within 30 days.

programs.name: Nicor Gas water heater
programs.rules: Gas tankless or condensing or power-vented tank, replacing a gas unit.

programs.name: Peoples Gas furnace
programs.rules: 95% or 97% efficient gas furnace. Apply within 30 days.

programs.name: Nicor Gas furnace
programs.rules: 95% or 97% efficient gas furnace replacing a gas furnace.

programs.name: Peoples Gas weatherization
programs.rules: Air sealing, attic, wall and duct work by an approved contractor. Insulation must be bundled with air sealing.

programs.name: Nicor Gas weatherization
programs.rules: Air sealing $500, attic $400, wall $150, foundation wall $200, duct sealing $600. The total shown adds all five caps.
